Write a practical notice for a fictional community tool library: reserve tools online, bring identification, and report damage before returning them. Avoid a marketing tone. Aim for approximately 60–85 English tokens.

message.content: Community Tool Library notice: Tools may be reserved online up to seven days in advance. Bring valid photo identification when collecting reservations. Inspect tools before use and report any damage, defects, or missing parts before returning them. Do not return damaged tools without notifying staff. Late returns may affect future reservations.
